From there, to honor the vision's Focal Point, we establish the Synthesis Node (MasterReviewer) as the absolute apex of the system, acting as the singular choke-point. Next, we build the Strategist's 'Fan-out' logic to populate this flat tree with hyper-specific micro-tasks. We then enforce 'Contextual Sensory Deprivation' by building a state-scrubber for micro-agents. Finally, we implement the strict, pulsing execution rhythm and layer on the 'Surgical Omniscience' terminal aesthetics using the defined Color Philosophy.

Block 1: Re-architect the orchestration state to use a flat adjacency array mapping `parentId` to `childId` across the MACRO, MESO, MICRO, and NANO taxonomy. [Acceptance Criteria: `state.ts` exports a flat-tree schema that explicitly replaces nested JSON arrays, validating against the 4-tier taxonomic boundaries.]

Block 2: Implement the `MasterReviewer` Synthesis Node as the singular architectural choke-point that evaluates the completed flat tree for masterpiece-level cohesion. [Acceptance Criteria: A dedicated Synthesizer module is created, ensuring a 100% single-reviewer funnel that aggregates executed micro-tasks and emits final approval without any alternative bypass.]

Block 3: Upgrade the Strategist engine to perform hyper-fractal fan-out, decomposing work into hyper-specific, non-generalist micro-tasks tied to the flat adjacency array. [Acceptance Criteria: Strategist logic forbids generalist prompts (e.g., "design the button") in favor of atomic commands, writing them strictly as flat parent/child relationships.]

Block 4: Build a "Contextual Sensory Deprivation" middleware that deliberately scrubs 90% of global state before passing instructions to isolated micro-agents. [Acceptance Criteria: The middleware function ingests a task and the global state, outputting a highly restricted, dark-room context for the Worker, proving zero lateral sibling visibility.]

Block 5: Refactor the execution engine to enforce a strict "fan-out, parallel freeze, fan-in" orchestration rhythm. [Acceptance Criteria: Orchestrator batches micro-agents into synchronized execution waves (no chaotic async racing) that fully resolve before routing upward to the Synthesizer.]

Block 6: Integrate the terminal logging UI to reflect the "Surgical Omniscience" emotion through the exact application of the Void Black, Electric Cyan, and Neon Gold color philosophy. [Acceptance Criteria: Console outputs pulse with the prescribed execution rhythm, logging Strategist branching in Cyan, worker isolation against Void Black, and final MasterReviewer synthesis in Gold.]
